doNot: Do not code before user approves ASCII after plan-checker passes.
Do not put height/aspect-ratio on section.con18; height = pt + title + panel + marquee + pb.
Do not hardcode 4 store cards in HTML; render via foreach from main_shop board.
Do not flatten c18_search into section-level rltv; it is an absol child of c18_panel with negative top so it overlaps panel top.
Do not include ca_name='new' rows in the left list; those rows feed only the bottom marquee.
Do not duplicate marquee text by hand; render TWO copies of the new-store strip via JS clone for seamless infinite scroll.
Do not break panel into rltv heightChain children for list/map; both are absol overlays inside the panel which owns 654 via aspect-ratio heightSource.
Do not use object-fit on map marker; CustomOverlay positions HTML element directly.
Do not flatten search input + button into separate siblings; they are co-positioned inside .c18_search wrapper as a single bar.

elements.name: c18_watermark
elements.heightSource: PSD 善美樂 watermark text 525x175 baked
elements.heightSourceReason: Decorative oversized watermark; aspect frozen on visible bbox to keep deco overlay independent of section heightChain.
elements.role: absolute decorative watermark behind title — not in heightChain

elements.name: c18_panel
elements.heightSource: PSD panel rect 1565x654 (사각형 579 복사 dark wrap)
elements.heightSourceReason: Panel is the visible figure containing search bar (overlay), left list, and right kakao map; panel height 654 is fixed by PSD design and the inner kakao map iframe needs a stable height anchor.
elements.allowSingleSceneOverlayReason: Panel acts as a fixed-aspect figure containing search overlay (top -35), white list (left 25.81%), and live kakao map iframe (right 74.19%). All three children are absol overlays inside the panel because (1) the panel's visible height is the source map iframe height, not a content stack, and (2) the search bar overlaps the panel top edge per PSD. Splitting list/map into rltv heightChain would require either flat siblings (loses panel boundary) or duplicated wrappers (extra DOM with no semantic meaning).
elements.siblingOverlayReason: Inside c18_panel three children intentionally co-exist as absol siblings: c18_search overlays top edge, c18_list fills left 25.81%, c18_map fills right 74.19%. They do not occupy the same space (search is on the top overlap row only; list and map split horizontally side-by-side at top:0).

children.name: c18_search
children.heightSource: PSD search bar (사각형 3 복사 804x74) + 검색버튼(73x73) combined width 877
children.heightSourceReason: Search bar visually combines white input rect (804x74) and dark search button (73x73) as one row with fixed height; absol overlay at -35px so it sits above panel top edge per PSD.
children.role: input + 검색버튼 combined; .c18_search_btn (right dark square 73x73 #231916) hosts con18_02.png search icon (28x28)

children.name: c18_list
children.heightSourceReason: Left store list is the white inner panel; height equals parent panel (654) and content scrolls inside it.
children.role: left white list scrollable container; stores rendered via PHP foreach. Active store gets a left indent marker (사각형 580 5d2b0d 8x234).

children.name: c18_map
children.heightSource: Kakao map container fills panel right area (1161x654)
children.heightSourceReason: Live kakao.maps.Map iframe needs a sized container; right area = panel width − list width.
children.role: kakao map div (id=c18Map). Markers use main_shop wr_7/wr_8 lat/lng via CustomOverlay; selecting a list card pans the map.

elements.name: c18_marquee
elements.heightSourceReason: Full-width brown strip with constant 83px height holds infinite-scroll text; aspect freezes strip height while text moves horizontally inside.
elements.role: infinite horizontal marquee — JS renders TWO consecutive copies of the new-store strip and translates -50% in a CSS keyframe loop. Source: main_shop rows where ca_name='new'. Text format: '미락육회막국수 {wr_subject} GRAND OPEN    ·    '.
